Title: General availability: Azure Cosmos DB for PostgreSQL now available in new regions

Body.Content:
You can now distribute your PostgreSQL database to horizontally scale queries across multiple machines using sharding in the new Sweden Central and Switzerland West regions for Azure Cosmos DB for PostgreSQL. The query engine parallelizes incoming SQL queries across the servers for faster responses on large datasets to provide greater scale and performance.

Learn more.
